decisions.minimal_patch: Versioned G3 current same-slot choice set approved by explicit operator: project_id, requirement_id, slot_id, candidate_id, immutable source original SHA, rights evidence SHA, requirement SHA, approval_record_id, snapshot head; optional reviewed derivative SHA, parent SHA, coordinate transform and reviewed polygon metadata.
